parts.text: The IGCSE class is determining the focal length of a lens. The apparatus is shown in Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1 A student places a lens at a distance u = 30.0 cm from an illuminated object. She moves the screen until a sharply focused image of the object is seen on the screen. She measures the distance v between the centre of the lens and the screen. She calculates d , using the equation d = u + v . She repeats the procedure using a range of values of u . The values of u , v and d are shown in Table 4.1. Table 4.1 u / cm v / cm uv / d / 30.0 29.8 59.8 45.0 22.0 67.0 50.0 21.8 71.8 55.0 21.0 76.0 60.0 19.9 79.9
